cross: Every seed x four actor-label pairs x starter 0/1 x physical swap false/true. These are 192 new initial games, not 384. Report actor pair and actual first/second AI separately.

diagnostic.description: Independent OR/AND proof of gaining a point within horizon, not cooperative reachability. Unknown on any cap. Original terminal wins/losses respected.

statistics.primary: Observed D vs A win-indicator difference on mixed games; no renormalization excluding unresolved
statistics.secondary: D/D minus A/A settlement, completed plies and quiet runs descriptive

adoption: No production/default AI promotion. D is not generally superior unless mixed-game observed win advantage is robust, settlement does not worsen, safety is maintained, and resource cost is acceptable. Human enjoyment and real-device performance remain untested.
limits: Frozen file before new outcomes, not external preregistration
Wall-clock caps are unresolved, never draws
Parallel workers share host, so timing is descriptive and cannot establish isolated device speed
No parameter tuning from fresh seed outcomes
Important-choice counts are an evaluator-based proxy, not validated human strategy
No official rules, boards, src, images, modes A-E, merging or deployment changes
